## Core Offerings & Differentiators
1. 100% Placement IT Bootcamps:
   - Full Stack MERN Development (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js, Next.js)
   - Python AI & Machine Learning Bootcamp
   - Java Spring Boot Enterprise Backend
   - C++ and Data Structures & Algorithms (DSA)
   - Real-world capstone projects, resume reviews, mock interviews, and guaranteed corporate placement drives.

2. Enterprise IT & Software Engineering:
   - Custom Business Billing & GST ERP Systems
   - Web Applications & E-Commerce Platforms
   - Native Android & iOS Mobile Applications

3. Hardware & Laptop Chip-Level Repair:
   - Same-day laptop motherboard repair (Dell, HP, Lenovo, Asus, Acer, Apple MacBook)
   - Chip-level BGA rework, screen replacement, hinge fixing, SSD/RAM upgrades, and data recovery.
